features: Smallest powerbank suitable for charging all compatible devices
Lightweight, compact and travel friendly design
description: Introducing the Stuffcool Giga 20000 mAh Power Bank with Type-C Cable, Black Super Fast Charging Powerbank, the smallest 20,000 mAh powerhouse designed to keep your devices fully charged on the go. Featuring a built-in Type-C cable with 65 W PD output, it effortlessly powers MacBooks, Laptops, iPhones, and Pixels. With 45 W Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0 support, your Samsung devices get a quick boost, while the 65 W PD PPS output charges iPhones and Pixels up to 50% in just 30 minutes. The USB-A port provides an additional 18 W for other devices, and its 45 W input ensures rapid recharging of the powerbank itself. Proudly BIS Certified and Made in India, this powerbank offers unmatched performance in a compact design, making it your perfect travel companion. *These Stuffcool Power Bank images are for illustration purpose only.
